# LifeOS

Read `CLAUDE.md` before anything else. Despite its name it is not Claude-specific: it is the contract for this folder, with the data schemas, the rules, and what each ritual does. `AGENTS.md` has the short version and a table of the ritual files under `.claude/skills/`.

When asked for a check-in, curation, weekly review or portfolio, open the matching `SKILL.md` and follow it step by step. Preserve JSON schemas and 2-space indent. Never backfill habit logs, never nag about missed days, never edit the append-only files (`unstick.json`, the learning `ledger`, `portfolio.json`) by hand.
